description: Net2 (Cherry Hills and Brushy Plains, New Haven, Connecticut) and Net3 (North Marin Water District, Novato, California) are two of the example distribution networks that ship with EPANET, contributed by Lew Rossman to the Water Distribution System Research Database as entries 20 and 21. Each entry offers a zip with the EPANET input file, and DataCite carries a DOI for each. The index page links the Journal of Environmental Engineering paper with DOI 10.1061/(ASCE)0733-9372(1994)120:4(803) beside Net2. The summary spreadsheet holds no counts for either. Coverage is a single US service area for each, at pipe-level detail; no dates are given beyond the 2016 deposit. The files are free; the pages state no licence beyond a copyright notice of the hosting institute, and the networks also ship with EPANET itself. Only the index page, the entry pages, the summary spreadsheet and DataCite metadata were read; no network file was downloaded or run. They serve as small teaching and test networks for hydraulic and water-quality simulation, leak and contamination studies, and software comparison. Related records: EPANET, the database record and the synthetic Net3 pipe-failure dataset.
